final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT c.gender AS g, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Orders o JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.date_order_placed >= '2013-10-25 17:40:25' AND o.date_order_placed <= '2017-05-24 19:26:44' GROUP BY c.gender), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(n) AS a FROM s1) SELECT s1.g, s1.n, s1.n - s2.a FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.a IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.n > s2.a
